data.title: Mike Waltz says Iran fears economic sanctions over US military attacks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: “When Iran is coming to the table with our negotiators, they are talking about cash, cash, cash. Because they’ll absorb the bombings," Waltz said in an interview with Fox News.
